content: Looking forward, the market is projected to grow at a compound annual growth rate of 11.58 percent, with expectations to hit 16.88 gigawatts by the year 2031 . When contextualized within the broader renewable energy landscape, South Africa's total renewable energy market was estimated to have grown to 18.18 gigawatts by 2026, with projections indicating a compound annual growth rate of 11.49 percent, potentially reaching an expansive 31.31 gigawatts by 2031 [54] . This rapid expansion highlights not only the increasing electricity demand but also a decisive, long-term pivot toward cleaner, more sustainable energy sources that require specialized electrical engineering and installation expertise.
